name: qWDTT Server Keenetic
description: Сервер защищённого туннеля qWDTT для Keenetic: WG/Raw-IP, профили, QR-ссылки, правила firewall и веб-статистика.

hints: AArch64 / ARMv7 / MIPSEL; no MIPS big-endian release asset
wireguard-tools, iptables, and TUN/WireGuard support or userspace backend
May configure firewall, routing and a WireGuard interface
Web UI listens on 0.0.0.0:3333 by default; check network exposure

notes: Download the IPK matching the router architecture from the upstream GitHub release.
Package install may stop/restart qWDTT and update firewall or tunnel state.
No external IPK is auto-installed by RouterForge; installation is preview-only.
The upstream project currently does not expose a license file; do not redistribute binaries without permission.
